ops.title: Preserve exact duplicate detection with a cold fold cache
ops.description:
Owner: /root/ccn_bounded_cache. Root-confirmed user-facing regression in independently landed PR147/main83e41c0560518d4ae79e79c23abd5d8d54a598b5. Prior accepted Dense9233 retains exact-duplicate detection on a cold/evicted fold cache;147 replaces full-kind duplicate candidates with listCached, which silently skips uncached tips. Its documented weaker contract and green CI do not authorize this change under the no-user-facing-changes requirement. Preserve foreign main/27; do not unilaterally revert it. Stable Dense28 uses reviewed dd/e3a without147.

Exact minimal private fixture: first := create(t,s,noteOps("X")); wipeCache(t,s); got := mustDedupe(t,s,noteOps("X")); require got.EntityID()==first.EntityID(). Each noteOps call uses a fresh create nonce but identical semantic title/body/tags/anchors. Prior path returns DuplicateError/survivor after reading the cold chain; new cached-only path can return a new entity/ID. This is source-derived, not a live customer duplicate test. Existing TestCreateFoldsNoUncachedChain creates DIFFERENT semantic payloads (cold/fresh), so it does not grade this counterexample.

Next executable step: design a keyed exact-content metadata lookup using existing authoritative metadata/index helpers, preserving canonical content comparison, liveness and CreatedAt/ID winner order. Add actual old/new negative controls and fixed-work32/10000 tests before a forward implementation; independent correctness/authority review is required. No normal Create may fold the whole kind to detect an exact duplicate, and no absent/partial/corrupt index may become false authoritative absence or silently create a duplicate. Do not invent a new fallback/migration framework or mutate/revert foreign main while design is pending. Dense installation remains independent priority.

Acceptance: preserve same-payload duplicate/survivor after fold-cache wipe, eviction, fetched-never-listed data and lifecycle transitions; prove bounded keyed work without unrelated body/history folds; retain missing-index/cancellation/concurrency/publication authority and all original duplicate parity tests. Then normal CI/merge/release/official installation and one controlled affected case, with protected sessions retained. No forced task closure, local build/test under saturation, or live user duplicate creation.

Evidence: FE/ccn147-dense-superset-source-review-input.json (87db8516) with exact four postimages and patch; ccn147-actual-pr-grade-and-review-state.json records PR147 all-green CI but no GitHub reviews/comments. Erroneous scope-acceptance4b1e was explicitly withdrawn in ccn147-dense-superset-independent-source-review.json (7e49656b) after Root refutation. All artifacts: /Users/yasyf/.local/state/host-pressure-recovery/runs/20261026T235128-repeat/fundamental-efficiency.

ops.text: Exact same semantic create after cold cache, eviction and fetch returns original DuplicateError/survivor with original winner ordering.
Keyed metadata lookup proves32/10000 work bounded independently of unrelated entities, with no normal-create whole-kind Git fold.
Authority, missing/partial/corrupt index, cancellation/concurrency and all existing duplicate parity tests pass actual CI and independent review.
Forward fix is merged, officially published/installed and controlled affected case passes without modifying foreign source or protected sessions.
